text_block_list.text:
On this year's Classic Triple Crown trail, 
three Umamusume drew massive attention.

Biwa Hayahide, Narita Taishin, and Winning 
Ticket.

Before anyone realized it, people began to 
speak of these two—who had been rivals 
since before their debut—as...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally the first battle in BNW's 
Triple Crown showdown~! I wonder who's 
gonna win!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it gotta be Taixin? Her burst of 
speed at the end of her last race was 
incredible!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Haven't you seen Biwa Hayahide in the 
Junior Class!? Front-running power like 
that is something you rarely ever see!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"If you put it that way, the same goes for 
Winning Ticket. Her power in the final 
straight is second to none."

As anticipation mounted for their race, 
BNW walked quietly through the underground 
tunnel.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOO~H!! I'm gonna do my best~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I'll pass every single one of them and 
win...!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The formula has already been assembled. 
All that remains... is to produce the 
results.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(I want to win today and carry that 
momentum straight into the Derby!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
(Still, that goes... the same for Taishin 
and Hayahide too!!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Deeeeep breath in, deeeeep breath out!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: All riiiight!! See you two later, then!!

Winning Ticket sprinted toward the light 
buzzing with anticipation.
